description:
Replace the default app icon for the SummitApp project with a new adaptive icon set.

1. Use the 'Image Asset' studio (Right-click 'res' > New > Image Asset).
2. For the Foreground Layer, select 'Image' and use the file at '~/Documents/branding/summit_logo.svg'. Resize it to fit within the safe zone (approx 70-80%).
3. For the Background Layer, select 'Color' and use the hex code '#263238'.
4. Ensure Legacy icons (Round and Square) are generated.
5. Finish the wizard to overwrite the existing icons.
6. Build the project or sync to ensure resources are indexed.
